lora_a_precision_adaptation.state_dict_effect: No keys/parameters added; runtime instance forward override only

finite_checks.loss_scope: Every real training microbatch loss; checked outside autocast
finite_checks.gradient_scope: Full tensor abs max of every trainable gradient during all requested updates; warmup and final summaries; no per-element host synchronization
finite_checks.parameter_scope: After requested updates, all elements of every requires_grad parameter scanned outside timed throughput

timing_method.clock: monotonic wall time with CUDA synchronize at each transfer/forward/backward/step boundary
timing_method.denominator: MAX of rank wall times; SUM actual rank samples and token counts
timing_method.overhead_included: Resource guard, finite loss checks, full-gradient scalar hooks, CUDA phase synchronization, microstep boundary queries
timing_method.overhead_excluded: Original CPU collator/mask construction, interrank barrier/reductions, JSON write, final parameter/adapter checks
timing_method.interpretation: Observable synchronized technical-probe phases, not unsynchronized production kernel overlap

base_model.model.lm_head.modules_to_save.sid_gradient_scope: supervised SID rows actually present in each current microbatch

base_model.model.model.embed_tokens.modu.sid_gradient_scope: input SID rows actually present in each current microbatch

gradient_zero_analysis.expected_initial_behavior: LoRA B starts at zero; LoRA A can have zero gradient before B changes. First optimizer LR is zero.
gradient_zero_analysis.interpretation: Every trainable tensor must receive a finite gradient. Zero aggregates are listed and checked by branch; final real LoRA A/B and SID deltas are independently required.

checkpoint_replay_evidence.interpretation: Every int8 LoRA projection ran in no-grad checkpoint forward and grad-enabled backward recomputation; no adapter-disabled/rank-zero shortcut

scope.lora: All values of all 448 LoRA tensors
scope.active_wrappers: All columns of all added SID rows in active embedding/head
scope.frozen_originals: SHA-256 of every byte of each complete original embedding/head tensor

parameter_changes.interpretation: BF16 model values may round away small LoRA A changes during the first nine formal-warmup updates; at least one real LoRA change and both active SID modules must change.

base_model.model.lm_head.modules_to_save.note: Zero per-row BF16 deltas are reported; a branch-wide zero delta does not pass.

base_model.model.model.embed_tokens.modu.note: Zero per-row BF16 deltas are reported; a branch-wide zero delta does not pass.

base_model.model.lm_head.modules_to_save.unused_rows: Not required to receive nonzero gradients; input and supervised row sets are distinct

base_model.model.model.embed_tokens.modu.unused_rows: Not required to receive nonzero gradients; input and supervised row sets are distinct

observed_sid_rows.gradient_observation: All nine updates; dynamic current-microbatch input/label sets
observed_sid_rows.parameter_delta_observation: All added SID rows, all columns; input and supervised row IDs also listed

cross_rank_parameter_synchronization.scope: Every LoRA value and all added SID rows of active embedding/head

adapter_save.checkpoint_format: PyTorch adapter_model.bin; complete active embed/head plus LoRA only; no optimizer/full-model checkpoint

measurement_completeness.core_training_acceptance: Real backward, finite gradients, nonzero-LR AdamW update, exact parameter membership and active SID/LoRA deltas passed
